name: Katonah Art Center Summer Camps
description_short: One week art camps at the Katonah Art Center studio in Mount Kisco, with half day and full day options. Art and Imagination camps serve ages 3.5 to 5, Kids Camp grades 1 to 5 and Teen Camps grades 6 to 12; campers pick one topic for each half day week.

fees.name: Extended day, morning
fees.note: 8:30 to 9:30 am, register at least 48 hours ahead for the week

fees.name: Extended day, afternoon
fees.note: 4:30 to 5:30 pm, register at least 48 hours ahead for the week

refund_policy_summary: Camp cancellations before April 1 are refunded less a $50 processing fee; before May 1, 50% less $50; no refunds after May 1 or for camps booked after May 1. Switching topic or week costs $25. Full refund if the center cancels.
notes: Summer 2026 rates: half day $435 a week, full day $870 a week (full day is a morning and an afternoon camp with an escorted lunch). Art and Imagination (ages 3.5 to 5) runs mornings 9:45 to 12:15 only. Kids and Teen camps run 9:30 to 12:30 and 1:30 to 4:30. Material fees may be added at checkout. No payment plans for camps. The 2026 session weeks are not shown on the site's text.
